title: Are Seismic Foundation Models More Than Glorified Feature Extractors?
abstract: arXiv:2610.38003v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Earthquake sequences are stochastic on two separated timescales: the seismic waves of any individual earthquake propagate over seconds to minutes, while the earthquakes themselves arrive as a sparse, self-exciting occurrence process, with inter-event intervals from seconds to months. Respecting both scales in one training objective is the open challenge. Foundation models (FMs) for seismic waveforms instead import their learning targets from audio and vision, where every target is computed from a single fixed-length window. Such a window holds one realization of the wave propagation (an earthquake trace), never the occurrence process that decides when earthquakes happen. We develop nine model designs sharing one Mamba encoder-decoder, trained on a fixed corpus of 3M windows, varying the self-supervised objective, quantization bottleneck and mixer; the two key comparisons are architecture-matched, varying the objective alone. translated_title: 地震基础模型是否不止是“华而不实的特征提取器”？
translated_abstract: 地震序列在两个相互分离的时间尺度上具有随机性：任何单次地震的地震波在数秒至数分钟内传播，而地震本身则以稀疏的自激发发震过程到达，事件间隔从数秒到数月不等。如何在单一训练目标中同时兼顾这两个尺度，是一个悬而未决的挑战。面向地震波形的基座模型（FMs）却从音频和视觉领域移植其学习目标，而在这两个领域中，每个目标都是从单个固定长度的窗口计算得到的。这样的窗口只包含波传播的一次实现（一条地震记录），却从不包含决定地震何时发生的发震过程。我们开发了九种共享同一 Mamba 编码器-解码器的模型设计，在包含 300 万个窗口的固定语料库上训练，改变自监督目标、量化瓶颈和混合器；其中两个关键比较是架构匹配的，仅改变目标函数。
tldr: 论文指出当前地震基础模型从音频/视觉领域移植的窗口级学习目标只捕捉单次波传播而忽略地震稀疏自激发的发震过程，并通过九种共享 Mamba 架构、仅改变自监督目标的模型实验，检验地震基础模型是否只是“美化的特征提取器”。
en_tdlr: The paper argues that current seismic foundation models import window-level learning objectives from audio and vision, capturing only single wave propagation realizations while ignoring the stochastic, self-exciting earthquake occurrence process, and tests through nine architecture-matched Mamba-based designs whether seismic FMs are more than glorified feature extractors.
